from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtInfo(BaseModel):
    """The court and case metadata identifying the judgment."""
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court, e.g., '北京市第四中级人民法院'")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number, e.g., '(2023) 京 04 执恢 20 号'")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of case, e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the dispute, e.g., '继承纠纷', '财产损害赔偿'")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The stage of the proceedings, e.g., '二审', '再审', '一审'")

class PartyInfo(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party, e.g., '夏某 1', '陈某'")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The role in the current document context, e.g., '上诉人', '被上诉人', '原审被告人'")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of party, e.g., '自然人', '公司'")

class FinancialOrder(BaseModel):
    """A financial order found in the judgment (fees, compensation, fines)."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial order, e.g., '案件受理费', '罚金', '赔偿金'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount ordered, e.g., '11800 元', '10 万元'")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost, e.g., '上诉人', '被告', '原告'")

class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """The final ruling and reasoning."""
    disposition: str | None = Field(description="The disposition outcome, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回再审申请', '维持原判'")
    orders_text: str | None = Field(description="Specific orders or changes to the previous judgment")
    reasoning_summary: str | None = Field(description="Key reason for the decision, e.g., '事实不清', '请求缺乏证据'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level class aggregating all extracted information from the document."""
    court_info: list[CourtInfo]
    parties: list[PartyInfo]
    financial_orders: list[FinancialOrder]
    judgment_outcomes: list[JudgmentOutcome]
